+title: 'agents-demo: default CLI, --watch, --marketplace'
+---
+## What
+Plan.md §13, the demo modes that need no chat. Look at `../FoundationModelsSkills/Examples/skills-demo/` and `SkillsDemoTests.swift` for the method.
+
+- `Examples/agents-demo/main.swift`: parse the mode, build the stack over `Examples/agent-library`, and dispatch.
+- `Examples/agents-demo/DemoModes.swift`: put the work of each mode in functions that take their dependencies (registry, runner, an output closure), so tests call them with the scripted profile and no process.
+  - default: the `AgentsCLI` driver over the fixture library.
+  - `--watch`: print one `AgentReloadReport` on each `onReload`.
+  - `--marketplace`: use `Examples/agent-library/marketplace` as a `file://` source of a `MarketplaceStore`, and list the agents with provenance.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift run agents-demo agent list` lists the fixture agents.
+- [ ] The `--watch` function prints a report after a file in a temporary copy of the library changes.
+- [ ] The `--marketplace` function lists `security-reviewer` and `doc-writer` with their marketplace provenance.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentsDemoTests.swift`: run the built `agents-demo` binary for `agent list` (as `SkillsDemoTests` does) and call the `--watch` and `--marketplace` functions directly.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter AgentsDemoTests`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
